name: aether
description: The search engine whose user is an agent. Aether returns citation-complete payloads — exact SEC section text, form type, filing date, accession-numbered citation, sec.gov source URL, confidence score — for SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, S&P 500 x 10y, 1.4M+ chunks), earnings-call transcripts (by speaker turn), and a 29-act EU financial-regulation corpus (MiFID II, MiCA, DORA, AML). Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + cross-encoder + ticker-aware boosting) plus a two-sided financial-data marketplace. Free 3-month trial, no card.
author: EvidInvest
